pages.about:
Home/About

How the council works

Who decides what, who pays for what, and how to have your say.

Council, committees and staff

Twenty-four elected councillors set policy at full-council meetings. Four committees look at planning, finance, community and the environment. Around 600 staff deliver the services, from rubbish collection to building approvals.

Every vote is published with the paperwork seven days beforehand, and anyone may speak for three minutes in public question time.

pages.faq:
Home/FAQ
Help

FAQ

Answers to the questions we hear most.

How do I pay my assessment tax?

Online through the resident portal, at the counter, or at any participating bank branch. You will need your account number from the bill.

How long does a licence take?

Straightforward applications are approved in five working days. Premises requiring inspection take up to three weeks.

Can I attend council meetings?

Yes. All full council meetings are open to the public. Register at the front desk or watch the live stream.

Who do I call for a blocked drain?

Use the Report an issue form or call the 24-hour hotline. We aim to attend within 48 hours.

Where can I find bin collection days?

Collection days are listed by zone on the Waste & recycling page.

How do I book a community hall?

Check availability online, then confirm with a deposit at the counter within three days.

Still have questions?

Our team is happy to help.

Contact us
